description: This file defines the AbstractApplication class, which serves as a base class for Spring Boot applications in the Eclipse Hono project. It manages service factories, deployment of service verticles, and application startup procedures.

classes.name: AbstractApplication
classes.description: A base class for implementing Spring Boot applications that deploy service verticles and manage service factories.

methods.name: addServiceFactories
methods.description: Adds provided service factory objects to the application's service factory set.

methods.name: deployRequiredVerticles
methods.description: Deployment hook invoked before service instances are deployed; defaults to a succeeded future.

methods.name: preDeploy
methods.description: Hook invoked before deploying each service instance; default does nothing.

methods.name: postDeploy
methods.description: Hook invoked after successful deployment of each service instance; default does nothing.

methods.name: deployVerticles
methods.description: Coordinates the deployment sequence: super deployment, required verticles, then service verticles.
